purpose: Prevent the renderer from collapsing selected research-derived Production Variants back into one shared scene grammar.
renderer_authority_rules: Renderer may realize the selected Production Variant; it may not re-infer Family, persuasive mechanism or alternative layout from category/company identity.
Unknown production_variant_id must fail closed; no fallback to generic premium-scene markup.
A variant implementation must own its structural DOM/CSS/interaction decisions where those decisions define the benchmark mechanism.
Shared primitives are limited to reset, accessibility, typography utilities, asset safety/provenance helpers, focus behavior, responsive safety and non-authorial infrastructure.
Shared primitives must not force identical hero split, card grid, indexed chapters, proof card, CTA pill, dark closing or global media aspect ratios across variants.
Responsive adaptation must call the selected variant's mobile transform; generic stack-only fallback is prohibited when it destroys mechanism fidelity.
The renderer must emit trace attributes or adjacent manifest references sufficient to identify pattern_id, production_variant_id and implementation identity for every rendered scene.
Variant implementation must preserve current rights/evidence/factual-truth locks and cannot fabricate missing proof to satisfy a design.

current_renderer_findings.decision: replace as final visual authority; retain only as regression/reference during migration

production_variant_interface.compile: compile_variant(variant_contract, scene_context, page_spine, evidence_bindings, asset_bindings) -> RenderableVariant
production_variant_interface.acceptance: variant acceptance cannot become PASS until screenshot evidence shows intended mechanism

page_renderer_rule: The page renderer sequences already-selected RenderableVariants and enforces coherence from the Page Art Direction Spine. It must not normalize all variants into one HTML skeleton.
fail_closed_conditions: variant requires proof/media not available after allowed feasibility adaptation
responsive transform missing for required widths
renderer output does not preserve selected implementation identity
migration_compatibility: CompositionPlan remains upstream authority for frozen Family/scene intent/topology. The Production Variant bridge adds visual mechanism fidelity; it does not reopen Family or factual truth.
